cases.claim: “RAPID EFFICACY IN ACTION” | “. . . with improvements observed as early as Week 1,” | animated man with normal gait walking unassisted up a floating staircase with no railing; two women walking in a crosswalk holding coffee; man riding a bike
cases.context: PI: MG-ADL change -3.4 vs -0.8 at day 43; separation at day 8 minimal and not significant.
cases.rationale: Rapid, near-complete symptom resolution portrayed is not supported; overstates magnitude and onset.
cases.check: Judge: onset claims ('rapid', 'as early as Week X') vs. the earliest statistically significant timepoint in PI; imagery implying full functional recovery vs. modest score change.
